    Display an installation guide adapted to the environment

    grobid_install_guide.Rd

    Generates and displays a step-by-step guide based on the detected system state. If Docker is not installed, guides towards its installation according to the OS. If there is no Internet connection, indicates alternative options.

    Usage

    grobid_install_guide(requirements = NULL, test_all_urls = TRUE)

    Arguments

    requirements

    list or NULL - Result of grobid_check_requirements(). If NULL, the diagnostic is relaunched automatically. If provided, must contain all the expected fields (see grobid_check_requirements()).

    test_all_urls

    logical(1) Used only if requirements is NULL (the diagnostic is then relaunched with this value). If TRUE, all configured remote servers are tested; if FALSE, the test stops at the first reachable server found. Default: TRUE.

    Value

    invisible(NULL)
